zh.title: 让真实科学问题进入下一代 AI 系统：DFM科学家合作计划正式启动
zh.summary: DFM科学家合作计划为 DFM 引入真实科学问题、高价值数据、可交互的科研环境与真实验证条件。首期重点关注生命科学与生物医学，同时面向化学、材料及其他前沿领域开放。
body: 2026 年 9 月 15 日，PhAI Labs 启动 DFM科学家合作计划。计划的作用是为 DFM 引入真实且重要的科学问题、高价值研究数据、可交互的科研环境、实验和专家反馈，以及能够检验系统判断的真实验证条件。
今天的 AI 已经能够检索文献、生成代码、处理数据并辅助完成部分科研任务。但真正的科学发现，往往始于一个尚未被清晰定义的问题。这些过程无法只在标准数据集或封闭任务中完成。AI 需要进入真实科研环境，接触科学家真正关心的问题，并从实验和现实反馈中持续学习。
首期重点关注生命科学与生物医学，同时面向化学、材料及其他前沿领域开放。我们希望寻找：有明确科学问题但缺少 AI 系统能力的科学家；拥有高价值数据或计算实验环境的实验室；可以提供真实验证条件的湿实验团队；希望共同探索 DFM 的青年 PI、博士后和博士生。
合作不是提交一个需求，而是共同推进一项研究。PhAI Labs 提供 AI 研究与工程支持、模型与计算资源、问题建模与联合验证；科学家提供领域判断和研究材料，并在授权范围内提供数据、工具或实验条件。进入实质性合作前，双方将通过书面协议明确数据使用范围、保密要求、成果发布与知识产权安排。
申请不需要先把问题整理成完整的项目方案。请告诉我们：你真正想理解的未知是什么，为什么它重要，目前的进展和主要困难是什么，以及已经具备哪些数据、工具或验证条件。详情与飞书申请表见合作计划主页。

en.title: Bring real scientific questions into next-generation AI: the DFM Scientist Collaboration Program opens
en.summary: The DFM Scientist Collaboration Program brings real scientific questions, high-value data, interactive research environments and real verification conditions into DFM. The first cohort prioritizes life science and biomedicine, while remaining open to chemistry, materials and other frontier fields.
body: On 15 September 2026, PhAI Labs launches the DFM Scientist Collaboration Program. The program brings DFM real and consequential scientific questions, high-value research data, interactive research environments, experimental and expert feedback, and real verification conditions that can test the system’s judgement.

AI can already retrieve literature, generate code, process data and assist with parts of the research workflow. But discovery often begins with a question that is not yet well defined. That process cannot happen only on static benchmarks or closed tasks. AI must enter real research environments, confront the questions scientists actually care about, and learn from experiments and reality.

The first cohort prioritizes life science and biomedicine, while remaining open to chemistry, materials and other frontier fields. We are looking for scientists with clear questions but limited AI systems capacity; laboratories with high-value data or computational environments; wet-lab teams able to provide real-world validation; and early-career PIs, postdocs and PhD students who want to explore DFM with us.

This is not a request queue but a research partnership. PhAI Labs brings AI research and engineering, models and compute, problem formulation and joint validation; scientists bring domain judgement and research context, and provide authorized access to data, tools or experimental conditions. Before substantive work begins, the parties document data scope, confidentiality, publication and IP arrangements in writing.

You do not need a complete proposal to apply. Tell us what you want to understand, why it matters, where the current work is blocked, and what data, tools or verification conditions already exist. Details and the Feishu application form are on the program page.
